test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fret
solution: The correct answer is **'Please'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Fret**__ **(verb)**- **to be worried and unhappy about something (किसी विषय में चिंतित और दुखी होना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- Don't **fret** - I'm sure he's OK. • __**Please**__** (verb)**- **to make somebody happy** **(**किसी को ख़ुश या प्रसन्‍न करना) __ • ​E.g.__- There’s just no **pleasing** some people. Hence, the correct answer is **'Please'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Bother**__** ****(verb)**- **to disturb, annoy or worry somebody** **(परेशान, तंग या चिंतित करना)** __ • **​E.g.__**- I’m sorry to **bother** you, but could I speak to you for a moment? • __**Worry**__** ****(verb)**- to think that something bad might happen or has happened (किसी दुर्घटना की आशंका से चिंतित होना) __ • ​E.g.__- There’s nothing to **worry** about. • __**Disturb**__** (verb)**- **to interrupt what someone is doing (किसी के कुछ काम करते समय उसमें बाधा पहुँचाना)** __ • **​**E.g.__- Please don't **disturb** your sister - she's trying to do her homework. a5:T80f,
